notes:
Summary: RunCrate builds an IDE-first platform (VS Code & JetBrains plugins) that offers workspace-local copilots, CI-integrated test runners, and centralized observability for build/test logs. Primary ask: function/tool-calling for code agents that can safely run tests, linters, and ephemeral build steps in a sandboxed environment and stream logs back to the editor with <200ms token latency for completion suggestions.

Key requirements (client language):
- Sandboxed execution: containerized (gVisor/firecracker) or K8s pod with strict resource limits and network egress controls; attestation for safe execution.
- Function-calling model: allow agent to call 'run_tests', 'run_lint', 'collect_build_logs' with structured outputs and exit codes. Must support streaming logs and incremental events.
- Model/version pinning: per-repo or per-team model pins + deterministic fallback to quantized variants when latency/cost tradeoff hit. Need SDK hooks for pinning APIs.
- Low-latency streaming: editor sessions require sub-250ms first-token latency on small prompts, and sustained low tail latency for interactive completions.
- Observability & retention: token-level cost breakdown per workspace, searchable build logs, and audit trails for function invocations.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), enterprise KMS/HSM, ISO27001 artifacts, data residency in NA/EU, retention controls.

POC scope: sandboxed test-runner POC (2 repos), VS Code extension streaming integration, demo of pinned model and fallback routing. SEs suggested running a dedicated VPC deployment for the POC with optional on-prem test hosts to run ephemeral containers.

Quotes / customer language: "We need the copilot to be able to run our unit tests without exposing secrets or company network — logs in editor only, never exfil." — Lead Engineer.

Open items:
- Need Redwood to provide attestation approach for sandbox runtime (suggested options: signed container images + runtime attestation).
- Pricing clarification for persistent low-latency sessions vs batch inference for CI.
- Legal: telemetry retention clause and PII handling.

Next steps (short): SE to deliver design diagram + cost estimate by 2025-01-05; schedule security deep-dive with infra on 2025-01-12; legal to receive retention addendum draft.
